package.name: ipa_room_exploration
package.description: Coverage path planning for rooms. ROS2 port (rena-patches): only the boustrophedon coverage library is built. The other explorers (flow-network / convex-SPP / neural-network / grid-point — several need CoinOR), the dynamic_reconfigure config, the cob_map_accessibility_analysis dependency and the actionlib server are dropped; a ROS2 action server is added separately.
